=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
text minus "-"
text t1 "ways to make 100 cents from 1, 5, 10, 25: "
text t2 "ways to make 100000 cents from 1, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100: "
global ways ulong 100001
global coins ulong 6
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note addcoin lets every amount from c up to amt also end with a coin c
fn addcoin amt ulong c ulong to void
for x ulong add sub amt c 1
y = add x c
w = add get ways y get ways x
put ways y w
end
end
note count is the classic change-making dynamic program: ways[a] counts the multisets of the first k
note coins that sum to a; adding coin c lets every amount a >= c also end with a c
fn count amt ulong k ulong to ulong
for a ulong add amt 1
put ways a 0
end
put ways 0 1
for i ulong k
addcoin amt get coins i
end
ret get ways amt
end
fn main to int
put coins 0 1
put coins 1 5
put coins 2 10
put coins 3 25
put coins 4 50
put coins 5 100
emit t1
emitu count 100 4
emit nl
emit t2
emitu count 100000 6
emit nl
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
ways to make 100 cents from 1, 5, 10, 25: 242
ways to make 100000 cents from 1, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100: 13398445413854501
</pre>
